notes:
Implementation notes for WI-15:

1. SEED DATA: DevelopmentSeeder creates the full demo fleet graph: Fleet 'demo' (Taxi Demo Kolín), 1 FleetAdmin (admin@demo.local), 1 Dispatcher (dispatcher@demo.local), 3 Drivers (driver1-3@demo.local), 3 Vehicles, 1 Tariff (40/28/5/100), 2 Zones (KH + Kolín circles r=4km), 3 Routes, 5 sample orders (DEMO01-05) driven through OrderService. Seeder is idempotent: keyed on fleet slug 'demo' existing.

2. SEED DRIVER PASSWORDS: All 5 staff users (admin, dispatcher, driver1, driver2, driver3) are seeded with 'Demo1234!' so the E2E test can perform real staff logins without AuthHelpers. This was added beyond the WI spec (which only mentioned admin/dispatcher) per the carry-forward requirement that the E2E driver must log in.

3. MIGRATION AT STARTUP: Program.cs applies MigrateAsync() in Development after Build(), before Run(). Tests continue to apply migrations via PostgresFixture.InitializeDatabaseAsync() independently. Gated by IsDevelopment() so it only runs in compose/dev.

4. SEED:ENABLED FLAG: DevelopmentSeeder is always registered in Development DI. Automatic seeding at startup is gated by Seed:Enabled config (default true). TaxiApiFactory now sets 'Seed:Enabled=false' so existing tests are unaffected. Seed tests call DevelopmentSeeder.SeedAsync() directly via scope.

5. CLOCK-TRAP WORKAROUND: E2ETaxiApiFactory extends TaxiApiFactory (which had to be unsealed) and PostConfigures JwtBearerOptions with a LifetimeValidator delegate wired to FakeTime. Tokens minted by JwtIssuer (using pinned FakeTimeProvider at 2026-09-10 12:00 UTC) are accepted by JwtBearer even when the real wall clock is outside the 15-minute window. FakeTime is NOT advanced — advancing would age seeded orders and trigger background job timeouts against the shared DB.

6. EVENT ORDERING FIX: GetOrderEventsEndpoint secondary sort by ThenBy(e => e.Id) added. Without this, events with identical timestamps (all fake-clock events) are returned in arbitrary DB order, causing non-deterministic event sequence in the E2E test when run as part of the full suite. UUIDv7 IDs are monotonically increasing within a time bucket, so secondary sort by Id gives stable insertion order.

7. NOOPREALTIMEPUBLISHER REMOVED: NoOpRealtimePublisher.cs deleted (carry-forward 5). The one usage in OrderServiceTests.CreateOrderService() was replaced with RecordingRealtimePublisher.

8. TAXIAPIFACTORY UNSEALED: TaxiApiFactory was originally 'sealed'. Changed to non-sealed to allow E2ETaxiApiFactory to extend it. ConfigureWebHost override in E2ETaxiApiFactory calls base.ConfigureWebHost(builder) first.

9. OPENAPI GENERATE TEST: OpenApi_Document_GeneratesApiMarkdown fetches /swagger/v1/swagger.json, groups operations by tag (sorted alphabetically), renders a markdown table per section, appends a static footer (error codes, concurrency, tenant isolation), and overwrites docs/api.md. The test always overwrites — the file cannot drift from the live API surface.

10. OPENAPI VERIFY TEST: OpenApi_Document_ListsAllExpectedEndpoints fetches /swagger/v1/swagger.json and asserts an explicit expected set of (verb, route) pairs (35 routes). Fails with missing/extra diff so a dropped FeatureConfiguration is caught.

11. E2E TEST FLOW: Driver1 is seeded as Free (Status=DriverStatus.Free, CurrentVehicleId=vehicle1) by the seeder. E2E test does NOT call GoOnline — driver1 is already online. The seeder sets Driver.Status directly (only order.Status is restricted to OrderService). E2E flow: dispatcher login → create order → driver1 login → dispatcher assign driver1 → driver1 accept → arrive → start → complete → dispatcher gets events → asserts sequence [Created, Assigned, Accepted, Arrived, Started, Completed].

12. SEED TEST HARDENING: Order count assertions in Seed_Development_CreatesDemoFleetGraph now filter by fixed public codes (DEMO01-DEMO05) rather than fleet membership alone. This prevents the E2E test (which creates a 6th order in the same demo fleet) from causing false failures when tests run in different order.

13. DEAD CODE REMOVED: outerScope parameter removed from DevelopmentSeeder.TransitionViaOrderServiceAsync (was passed to the method but never used inside it). Stray client.DefaultRequestHeaders.Remove("X-Fleet-Slug") removed from E2E test. Long scaffolding comment block in DevelopmentSeeder replaced with concise factual comments.

14. DECISIONS.MD: Appended assumptions 1-11 (echoed from work-items doc), WI-03 nullability micro-deviations (OrderEvent.FromStatus, Route.ValidFromTime, AuditLog.ActorUserId), and WI-15 specific decisions (seed passwords, Seed:Enabled flag, migration at startup, api.md generation, clock-trap workaround, tiebreaker sort, NoOp removal).

15. DEMO.MD: Created at docs/DEMO.md (designer's files_touched listed root DEMO.md; placed in docs/ to keep root clean — deviation documented in decisions.md).

MICRO-FIX PASS (impl-reviewer F1/F2/F4 from handoff-impl-reviewer.json round=1 for WI-14, re-used as findings for WI-15 by conductor):
- F2 (weak E2E assertion): Replaced HaveCountGreaterThanOrEqualTo(6) + ContainInOrder(...) with exact eventTypes.Should().Equal("Created", "Assigned", "Accepted", "Arrived", "Started", "Completed"). The flow is deterministic: exactly 6 events, no extras. Assertion passed immediately confirming the seeder and endpoint produce exactly the expected sequence.
- F4 (visibility): Changed DevelopmentSeeder from public sealed to internal sealed. No accessibility errors — InternalsVisibleTo in the test project covers the one test-only consumer (RunSeederAsync via GetRequiredService<DevelopmentSeeder>). The class is same-assembly in Taxi.Api from Program.cs registration, so no issues there either.
- F1 (api.md drift): After the two code fixes, ran the full suite which caused OpenApi_Document_GeneratesApiMarkdown to regenerate docs/api.md from the live OpenAPI document. Then git add -A staged the regenerated file, ensuring staged api.md == generator output.
